Hi Anika,

Thanks again for taking time last week. As promised, I attached a first draft of a Partner Operations Charter specifically tailored for Helix's integrator practice. High-level goals:

- Accelerate Helix consultants to billable delivery on Redwood in 6 weeks
- Provide two-tier accreditation (Practitioner / Accredited Integrator)
- Run a pilot cohort of 3 customer-facing engineers with hands-on labs and one co-delivery engagement

Key artifacts attached: Helix_Onboarding_Charter_v1.pdf and SI_Practical_Labs_List.xlsx. The charter includes proposed milestones, success metrics (time-to-first-project, lab pass rate), and recommended internal resourcing from both sides.

As immediate next steps, can you:
1) Confirm the pilot cohort size and target pilot customer(s) by end of next week
2) Share any constraints on Helix training days in Oct/Nov

If that sounds right, Jonas and Monica from our Partner Success team will scope the curriculum and schedule the pilot sessions.

Suggested pilot window: Oct 9 — Nov 20 (6 weeks). We can compress if Helix prefers a 3-week fast-track.

Open to changes — this is intentionally a tight draft so we can iterate.

Best,

Tessa Morgan

Really appreciate the quick turnaround and the level of detail. Helix is excited to get our team certified on Redwood. A few clarifying questions from our side:

- Accreditation levels: can you share the assessment criteria for Practitioner vs Accredited Integrator? We want to ensure the badges map to our internal career ladder.
- Pilot customers: we can line up two sandbox-friendly customers (both on AWS) — one with a 1-2 week PoC scope and one smaller integration-first project.
- Resource ask: we have one enablement lead (me) + 3 engineers for the cohort. We may need an extra co-delivery day from Redwood during week 4.

Also — October 9 works for a 2-hour orientation session. Can we lock that date and get a calendar invite?

If you prefer, I can loop in our legal ops for a short SOW for the pilot; otherwise we can run it under our existing master partner agreement.

On Wed, Sep 18, 2029 at 11:06 AM Anika Rao <anika@helix-consulting.com> wrote:
> Tessa —
>
> Really appreciate the quick turnaround and the level of detail. Helix is excited to get our team certified on Redwood. A few clarifying questions from our side:
>
> - Accreditation levels: can you share the assessment criteria for Practitioner vs Accredited Integrator?

Thanks Anika — tagging in high-level alignment here. A few notes from delivery/technical side:

- Assessment framework: pass/fail practical labs + a short design review. Practitioner = complete labs (70%+ pass rate) + one recorded design review. Accredited Integrator = practitioner requirements + two live co-deliver sessions evaluated by Redwood SME. We'll document rubrics in the Drive link.
- Co-delivery day: we can commit to 1 co-delivery day in week 4 (SME + rehearsal). If Helix needs more, we should scope additional days in the SOW.
- Pilot schedule: propose orientation (2 hrs) Oct 9, weekly lab sessions (2 x 90 min) alternating hands-on + design review, and a final capstone co-delivery in week 6. I attached a calendar stub (pilot-schedule.ics) and a quick milestone table.

Action items I propose:
1) Tessa: confirm Redwood SMEs for weeks 3 and 6 (I recommend Priya N. and Marcus L.)
2) Anika: confirm cohort roster by Sep 25 and Pilot customer(s) by Sep 29
3) Monica/Sean: prepare credentialing/reporting templates for partner portal ingestion

We should also create a short feedback loop for quality monitoring (post-lab surveys + 1:1 retro). Happy to walk through this on a 30-min sync if helpful.

Jonas Weber
Partner Success Architect | Redwood Inference
